'''Water-spiders''' were sizable arachnids whose large footpads allowed them to walk on water. They were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]].<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
